shape_note: Card-program templates with symbolic references ($controller, $opponent, $card, $chain_item, $source_object), bound per fixture by r3a1_programs.bind() into a concrete effect-program.v1 / play declaration. No literal player id may appear in a template; fixtures carry `bindings` and every program fixture is also run mirrored (players swapped) and must produce the player-relative same result before a clause can be full or partial. Fixture setups are edits over check_effect_ir.base_state(): u1 = p1 unit 3 Might 1 damage at base; u2 = p2 unit 4 Might exhausted at base; c1,c2 = p1 spells in deck; c3 = p1 spell in trash; c4 = p2 spell in deck; r1 = p1 rune in rune_deck; bf1 empty. Expected outcomes cite the Core clause they follow, not the engine.
